mechanism.covariance: symmetric scalar representation with Joseph covariance update for local-trend arms
mechanism.learned_variances: softplus(log_q_level), softplus(log_q_slope), softplus(log_r), each plus 1e-6 floor; one scalar per state family shared over selected channels

mechanism.precision: FP32 model/input/state/loss/gradient/optimizer; autocast and GradScaler disabled; CUDA TF32 disabled; official centered-moment metric may accumulate in FP64
mechanism.known_runtime_risk: filter is an eager Python loop across time; the 448-feature all112 projection and activation memory require actual B300 profiling

statistics.primary_estimand: D=1/4 sum_f [1/n_f sum_s (WP(candidate_f,s)-WP(control_f,s))], n_f=(8,8,7,7); score each endpoint before pairing
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across all eight predeclared contrasts if all are reported
statistics.uncertainty: Seed variability: use NumPy PCG64 seed 20261018 and 10,000 percentile-bootstrap replicates. Draw eight seed identities with replacement from 1001-1008 and apply the same multiplicities across folds. For each fold renormalize over its available cells (F0/F1 have eight seeds; F2/F3 have seven); redraw if any fold receives zero available multiplicity. Compute each fold's seed-mean paired WP difference, then average the four fold means equally. Evaluation-unit variability: use a separate NumPy PCG64 seed 20261019 and 10,000 paired source-component bootstrap replicates. Within each fold f, draw C_f component IDs with replacement exactly C_f times, where C_f is that fold's number of unique evaluation components. Apply each draw's component multiplicities jointly to all sequences in a component, both treatment/control endpoints, and every available seed cell; recompute pooled official WP for each endpoint/cell, average paired seed differences within fold, then average the four fold differences equally. For each procedure report the empirical 2.5th/97.5th percentile interval separately; each interval conditions on fixed fitted endpoints and the four exposed folds and captures only its named resampling axis.
statistics.decision_policy: A zero-crossing interval is inconclusive, not a universal kill; preserve valid cells and report fold/seed variation and measured runtime separately.

limits: No B300 hardware profile, runtime, model fit, cache or task grade is present.
The local Python time loop and all112 projection may be too slow or memory-intensive; the B300 profile is a hard gate.
A source-qualified four-family clean-fold teacher registry is required before any student cache or student fit.
The four-channel pilot indices are anonymous local selections; pilot evidence does not transfer to all112.
The NumPy receipt is synthetic-only, not task evidence or PyTorch parity; its reported peak RSS exceeds the intended support bound and resource verification is unconfirmed.
Two epochs are a fixed screening budget, not a convergence claim.
This draft does not implement torchrun/DDP, online student integration, larger-teacher scaling, or competition packaging.
